title: Gauss completes the Lean formalization of the dimension-8 sphere packing proof
summary: Math Inc's autoformalization model Gauss completed the final stages of the Lean verification of Viazovska's proof that the E8 lattice is the optimal sphere packing in dimension 8, working with the human formalization team. The paper describes the human-AI collaboration and the verification in the Lean kernel, with the milestone dated February 2026 in the abstract. Formalization of an existing 2016 result, not a new theorem, and the paper is a progress report.
ai_technology: Gauss (Math Inc autoformalization model) with Lean
organization: Math Inc; Hariharan, Viazovska and collaborators
